description: Use when the user gives you a link to a video (a screen recording, product walkthrough, bug repro or design review: an .mp4/.mov/.webm URL, or a public Google Drive or Dropbox link) and you need to know what it shows or asks for, because you cannot watch video. Tellscreen transcribes it, looks at the screen at the moment each thing was said, and returns Markdown: a summary, every change asked for with the words said, where on screen, how to check it is done and a screenshot link of that moment, then the timed transcript. Waits up to 50 seconds; if it is still working you get a job id for get_change_list. Loom and YouTube pages cannot be fetched: ask the user for the downloaded file instead and use convert_local_video.

url.description: Direct link to the video file, or a public Google Drive / Dropbox link.

name: convert_video_link
title: Turn a video link into a change list
